items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: All I wanted to do was get off that stage. Let me out of here. Because these cats, man – Tommy Potter, Max Roach, Al Haig – were burnin’.

ctx.x: Did he ask you what you wanted to sing?

No. They played The Song is You, and he just – he motioned to me like that. So after Kenny Dorham got through – no, after he got through, he was motioning to me. So I walked up on the stage, and I scatted on The Song is You. He heard me make those Art Tatum changes, because that’s where he was from. After I was through, my knees were knocking. I was so nervous, I thought I was going to faint. All I wanted to do was get off that stage. Let me out of here. Because these cats, man – Tommy Potter, Max Roach, Al Haig…
Was that a milestone for you? How did that affect you?
